scope: Exact local identities and bounded falsification; no closed infinite-orbit class or novelty claimed.

plan.signatureTarget: Strict supply-surplus booleans at 2,3,5,7 and A7 membership of the successor.
plan.scope: Rules fixed before this diagnostic run; source traces were previously explored, not blind holdout data.

verification.input: Independent Lucas-prime and divisor-enumeration replay before analysis.
verification.census: Trial factors and prime-power formulas checked against an independent additive divisor sieve.
verification.censoring: Unknown factors, undecidable membership and unobserved continuation are never failures or successes.
verification.returns: First returns are not filtered for gains; profitable-checkpoint existence is a separate bounded search.
verification.sharing: Unique-source diagnostics are deduplicated; per-seed and overlapping-window counts are not independent trials.
verification.signatures: Source-only supply/tie features; actual prime labels outside 2,3,5,7 deliberately omitted in compressed signatures.
